answer: Each identity is a vessel moored in the harbor on a $50 bond; only inner-harbor vessels vote. Each epoch the lighthouse beacon sweeps at one unpredictable minute inside a delta window, and every vessel must flash its pulse within 15 minutes. One miss doubles the fee and drifts the vessel outward; a second miss slashes half the bond and expels it, forcing re-mooring. Forging 1,000 Sybil IDs locks $50,000 and needs 1,000 live signers ready for an unpredictable sweep each epoch — $60,000 a month before the first forged vote. Like a harbor at night: a ghost ship cannot answer the lighthouse.
